cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Supportive Rage
cards.instruction: Remain helpful and encouraging while becoming increasingly furious.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Choose the birthday lunch you really want. I'll drive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The seaside place. We'd lose your deposit here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Forty pounds wasted. Fine. You love the sea; let's make a day of it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked it. They need another forty now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Another forty? Eighty pounds before a bloody sandwich. Give me the number. You're getting your sea view. Ask for a window; you deserve one.

mechanism: A manages B desired birthday change with exact booking corrections while costs make A increasingly furious without withdrawing encouragement.
confusable: Resentful compliance alone lacks active support; A must continue securing the desired meal and encouraging B choice while visibly angry.
comparison: Paint alternative protects a frightened helper during a mess; lunch alternative supports B preference despite accumulating personal cost.
seedUse: Seaside choice and two deposits derive from D21-b; S03 turns supportive logistics into correction of cancellation and reservation requirements.
